What counts as active?

**Active** means a dated record of the company operating or keeping itself in good standing on or after Jan 1, 2022: a filing the company has to make (registry, tax or benefit-plan filing, federal registration, license), or a registry status or company website we saw in a current snapshot. A status reads “as of” the latest snapshot that shows it, and “since” only when we saw it begin. PPP loan and incorporation dates are not counted. Filled dots are strong evidence; faint dots are weaker signals, such as a business listing, shown but not counted; hollow dots are history.
